protectedInterfaceOriginal: No general Weave casting; class power is entirely positional and martial.
engine: A martial class with d10 Hit Die, all armor and shields, repeating crossbows, sidearms and siege tools. Dexterity governs ranged attacks; Constitution governs class DC/M and defensive techniques. No RP, ordinary spellcasting, Refrain or Dissonance engine. Names such as Divine Lockdown describe disciplined suppression; they do not grant divine magic.

Overwatch is an automatic Base engine at 1. Bonus Action designate a visible 15 ft square within weapon range until start next regular turn. Once during that interval, spend your Reaction when a perceived enemy enters, moves inside, attacks an ally from, or reveals itself inside the zone. Make one legal ranged attack with ammunition and line of fire, normally 1d8+DEX piercing. On hit choose Snare (Speed-10 ft until end next turn), Bleed (1d4 at start next turn), or Push 5 ft (STR save negates push). Concealment still applies. Only one Overwatch zone; no extra Reaction. The optional Overwatch card upgrades this engine. At 17 you may move 5 ft without opportunity attacks after its shot, once/round.

At 5 automatically gain Palisade Deployment. Spend one carried barricade kit and an Action to erect a 2-by 1-tile wall in contiguous unoccupied ground within 5 ft. Height 5 ft, AC 12, HP 5+CON modifier minimum 1, immunity psychic/poison; blocks movement and line of sight across its full height but can be climbed using 10 ft movement. One kit/use per encounter, two at 13; a long rest with carpentry tools replenishes 2 kits (carried maximum 2, reusable parts have no resale value). Material is required; no conjuring. At most one intact wall, two at 13. Old wall must be dismantled in 1 minute before replacement beyond cap. Once per encounter an Action repairs a wall for M HP using spare parts; destruction does not refresh uses.

Palisade Tier II at 13 doubles wall HP and grants resistance to damage from area effects. Hold Position: while adjacent to your intact wall gain+1 AC and+1 saves. Brace Line: an ally immediately behind you relative to a ranged attacker, with your wall adjacent to both of you, has 2 flat DR against that attacker. These bonuses do not stack with another Soldier wall; strongest flat DR applies. Full cover prevents attacks rather than granting an additional AC bonus.

Base 1–2, Commander Arch 3–9, then Champion/Artillerist/Tyrant Hero 10–20. Palisade 5 is automatic; Intercepting Shot has minimum 6 and Fortify Zone 9. Other cards require selection. There is no source automatic Arch capstone. At 20 gain the new Final Command below, clearly a playtest addition. No spell or sustained technique may be used to obtain infinite ammunition, structures, actions or permanent healing.
workedExample: Soldier 6, DEX 16, CON 16, PB 3, S 2, M 3. Carry 2 barricade kits and begin with one encounter deployment available.
Turn 1 Action deploy a 10-by 5 ft wall: kits 2→1, encounter uses 1→0, wall HP 8. Bonus Action designate Overwatch. Standing adjacent grants+1 AC/+1 saves.
Enemy moves inside zone; Reaction attack hits for 1d8+3. Choose Snare: Speed-10 ft through end of its next turn. You cannot also use Intercepting Shot before your Reaction refreshes.
Turn 2 use Covering Fire: one ranged attack with its printed rider. You cannot add an ordinary Attack Action. Renew Overwatch with Bonus Action; its next shot still needs your Reaction.

If the wall is destroyed, encounter deployment stays 0. An intact wall could receive its once/encounter repair for 3 HP. After combat a new encounter still requires a carried kit; long rest restores at most 2 kits.
balanceQuestions: Does Overwatch meaningfully influence enemy movement without deciding every turn?
Are finite barricade kits practical to track?
Do support actions compete fairly with attacking?

cards.name: Overwatch
cards.effect: Increase zone to 20 ft square. After a qualifying enemy triggers it you may decline the shot and keep waiting until zone expires. Still only one Reaction shot and normal sight requirements.

source.originalText: Overwatch: Set up a reaction shot against movement in your designated zone.

cards.name: Shield Trained
cards.effect: Wield a repeating crossbow with a strapped shield; reloading still needs an available hand or the repeating mechanism. If you have moved 0 ft since start last turn gain 1 flat DR. Forced movement ends the benefit.

source.originalText: Shield Trained: Wield a shield alongside your crossbow and gain +1 Damage Reduction when stationary.

cards.name: Tactical Awareness
cards.effect: Gain+2 Perception and initiative. Does not reveal unseen creatures automatically or allow attacks without line of fire.

source.originalText: Tactical Awareness: Gain advantage on perception checks related to battlefield threats.

cards.name: Defensive Positioning
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self adjacent to solid terrain or your cover
cards.effect: Gain+1 AC. Does not stack with Hold Position or another copy of this feature; full cover follows ordinary rules.

source.originalText: Defensive Positioning: Gain +1 AC when adjacent to terrain or structures.

cards.name: Steady Aim
cards.effect: Ignore the AC bonus from half cover. Three-quarter and full cover still apply; this is not permission to shoot through allies or walls.

source.originalText: Steady Aim: Ignore partial cover when making ranged attacks.

cards.name: Covering Fire
cards.effect: Make one ranged weapon attack. On hit normal damage and target has-2 on its next attack against an ally other than you. Further Covering Fire replaces rather than stacks this penalty.

source.originalText: Covering Fire: Fire a volley that forces enemies in a line to take cover or suffer damage.

cards.name: Quick Deploy
cards.effect: Place low cover from carried field supplies: AC 12, HP 5, grants half cover and is difficult terrain. It is not a full palisade and does not grant its bonuses. One at a time; no transferable saleable material.

source.originalText: Quick Deploy: Set up a temporary barricade that provides partial cover.

cards.name: Warning Shot
cards.effect: Make a ranged attack; on hit deal weapon die only and impose disadvantage on its next attack. Does not force it to attack or expend an action.

source.originalText: Warning Shot: Fire a deterrent shot that imposes disadvantage on an enemy's next attack.

cards.name: Tactical Reposition
cards.effect: Move up to half Speed without opportunity attacks. Requires an open route; no teleporting, escaping restraints or attacks.

source.originalText: Tactical Reposition: Move half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

cards.name: Rally Point
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies within 15 ft who hear you
cards.effect: Each gains M temporary HP and+1 on the next saving throw before duration ends. Temporary HP follows strongest-only rule and is lost at encounter end.

source.originalText: Rally Point: Designate a location that grants allies who move there a small defensive bonus.

cards.name: Command Step
cards.effect: After you take an Action, ally may move 5 ft without opportunity attacks. No extra action, attack, teleport or movement through blocked spaces.

source.originalText: Command Step: Once per round, shift one adjacent ally 1 tile in any direction.

cards.name: Formation Lock
cards.effect: Enemies gain no flanking bonus from surrounding protected creatures. Other sources of advantage and cover remain; allies need not spend reactions.

source.originalText: Formation Lock: Allies adjacent to you cannot be flanked.

cards.name: Iron Orders
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies within 15 ft who hear you
cards.effect: Gain+1 AC and+1 saves against Frightened. This AC bonus does not stack with other Soldier formation/aura AC bonuses; use highest.

source.originalText: Iron Orders: All allies within 3 tiles gain +1 Save vs Fear and +1 AC.

cards.name: Palisade Deployment
cards.effect: Automatic engine, not a selected skill. Build the palisade with the exact statistics, kit and repair rules in the class engine. Source minimum 5 retained.

source.originalText: Palisade Deployment: Deploy a 2x1 barrier that blocks movement and line of sight (level 5).

cards.name: Intercepting Shot
cards.rangeAndTarget: Attacker within 25 ft that you perceive
cards.effect: When it hits an ally within 25 ft, attack it before damage. On your hit reduce triggering damage by S+M, minimum 0. Your shot deals weapon die only. Does not undo a hit or block an area effect against everyone.

source.originalText: Intercepting Shot: Use your reaction to fire at an enemy about to hit an ally within 5 tiles (level 6).

cards.name: Fortify Zone
cards.effect: Designate fortified firing lanes. Ranged attacks against up to 3 allies inside take-2 to hit while you remain conscious within 30 ft. Does not affect saves, melee attacks or attacks from inside zone.

source.originalText: Fortify Zone: Enemies in a 3x3 area take –2 to ranged attacks against your allies (level 9).

cards.name: Tactical Assessment
cards.effect: Learn its current armor category and whether it has cover. Choose one ally: their next attack against it gains+1 to hit. No hidden statistics, mind-reading or vulnerability invention.

source.originalText: Tactical Assessment: Analyze the battlefield to gain information about enemy weaknesses.

cards.name: Coordinated Maneuver
cards.rangeAndTarget: One willing ally within 30 ft who hears you
cards.effect: Ally spends Reaction to move up to half Speed and make one weapon attack. This is one granted attack, not a full Attack Action; no Extra Attack. For cap purposes this granted move plus one weapon attack counts as the ally’s one additional full Action for the round; it still permits only one weapon attack and never Extra Attack.

source.originalText: Coordinated Maneuver: Direct an ally to move and take an action out of turn.

cards.name: Suppression Fire
cards.effect: Up to 3 perceived enemies in zone make DEX save. Failure: S d6 piercing and Speed-10 ft through end next turn; success half damage, no slow. Cannot shoot through full cover. No attack rolls or on-hit procs.

source.originalText: Suppression Fire: Create a zone that enemies must save against or take damage when entering.

cards.name: Defensive Formation
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 willing allies within 15 ft
cards.effect: Each may shift 5 ft without opportunity attacks and gains 1 flat DR while adjacent to another affected ally. Uses strongest DR, not an additive stack.

source.originalText: Defensive Formation: Arrange allies in an optimal pattern, granting defensive bonuses.

cards.name: Hold the Line
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy entering your melee reach
cards.effect: Make one melee weapon attack. On hit normal damage and STR save or Speed 0. This is soft movement control; teleportation and forced movement remain possible.

source.originalText: Hold the Line: Establish a defensive position that grants bonuses to allies behind you.

cards.name: Protective Aura
cards.effect: Advantage on saves against Frightened or Charmed. Does not end existing effects automatically or grant immunity to all mental effects.

source.originalText: Protective Aura: Nearby allies ignore fear and charm effects while you stand.

cards.name: Selfless Guardian
cards.rangeAndTarget: One adjacent ally taking direct weapon damage
cards.effect: Redirect up to S+M of that damage to yourself. Redirected damage cannot be reduced, redirected again or trigger retaliation. The ally takes the rest after its own mitigation.

source.originalText: Selfless Guardian: Take reduced damage when intercepting attacks meant for allies.

cards.name: Inspiring Presence
cards.rangeAndTarget: Allies within 15 ft who hear you
cards.effect: Gain+2 on saves against fear and checks to rally a routed formation. No generic bonus to all saves or attacks; does not stack with Iron Orders fear bonus.

source.originalText: Inspiring Presence: Allies within sight gain a bonus to morale saves.

cards.name: Defensive Expertise
cards.effect: Gain 2 flat DR against weapon damage. Use strongest DR; does not stack with Shield Trained, wall protection or Wall of Aegis.

source.originalText: Defensive Expertise: Gain additional damage reduction when using defensive abilities.

cards.name: Guardian's Rush
cards.rangeAndTarget: One ally within 15 ft hit by attack
cards.effect: Move up to 15 ft along open ground to adjacent ally without opportunity attacks; reduce that hit's damage by 2 S+M. Cannot act while restrained or incapacitated. Does not transfer target or negate unrelated riders.

source.originalText: Guardian's Rush: Move adjacent to an ally being attacked, potentially intercepting the blow.

cards.name: Divine Lockdown
cards.effect: STR save each; failure Speed 0 and cannot take Reactions. Success Speed-10 ft only. This is physical suppression; teleport remains possible. No damage or additional free attacks.

source.originalText: Divine Lockdown: Prevent enemy movement in a small area (once per encounter).

cards.name: Wall of Aegis
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 3 adjacent allies
cards.duration: Until start of your second next turn
cards.effect: Gain 2 flat DR against all damage except psychic. Use strongest reduction once per damage packet; does not stack with other flat DR.

source.originalText: Wall of Aegis: Grant all adjacent allies +2 Damage Reduction for 2 rounds.

cards.name: Rallying Cry
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies within 30 ft who hear you
cards.duration: Instant; temp HP to encounter end
cards.effect: End Frightened on each and grant S+M temporary HP. Cannot revive, heal real HP or repeatedly refresh from imitation/copies.

source.originalText: Rallying Cry: Remove fear effects from nearby allies and grant temporary hit points.

cards.name: Sacrificial Defense
cards.rangeAndTarget: One adjacent ally that would reach 0 HP from damage
cards.effect: Reduce damage by up to your current HP minus 1, taking that amount as unmitigable damage yourself. Ally takes remainder. Cannot make either creature's HP negative, erase massive-damage rules or transfer the cost again.

source.originalText: Sacrificial Defense: Take damage in place of an ally, converting a portion to non-lethal damage.

cards.name: Enhanced Overwatch
cards.effect: A hidden enemy that attacks or moves inside must roll Stealth against your passive Perception; failure reveals its space until turn end. Invisibility still imposes its normal attack penalty. Total cover blocks detection and firing.

source.originalText: Enhanced Overwatch: Your Overwatch can reveal and fire on stealthed or invisible enemies.

cards.name: Tactical Reload
cards.effect: Reload its ordinary magazine without an action, consuming carried ammunition. No infinite ammunition or additional shots; incompatible with ammunition you cannot physically load.

source.originalText: Tactical Reload: Reload your crossbow as a free action once per round.

cards.name: Palisade Synergy
cards.rangeAndTarget: Your ranged weapon attack while adjacent to palisade
cards.effect: Add S damage. Does not apply to every shot, area save or turret hit, and requires an intact wall you deployed.

source.originalText: Palisade Synergy: Your attacks deal additional damage to enemies adjacent to your palisades.

cards.name: Precision Engineering
cards.effect: Increase maximum and initial HP by M. Does not heal existing damaged structures when learned or moved; repairing remains finite.

source.originalText: Precision Engineering: Your deployed structures have increased durability and effectiveness.

cards.name: Net Bolt
cards.effect: Ranged weapon attack; on hit S d4 bludgeoning and Restrained. Target or adjacent ally may use Action STR/Athletics against your DC to end, or destroy net AC 10 HP 5. Huge or larger targets instead lose 10 ft Speed. No automatic unsaveable imprisonment.

source.originalText: Net Bolt: Fire a specialized bolt that snares the target on hit (no save).

cards.name: Shatterburst
cards.effect: Up to 3 enemies DEX save, S d6 piercing on failure, half success. Failure also-1 attack rolls for duration. This save technique has no critical hits or weapon-hit riders.

source.originalText: Shatterburst: Fire a cone volley that imposes a -1 attack penalty on enemies for 1 round.

cards.name: Repel Shot
cards.rangeAndTarget: Enemy within 30 ft moving toward you
cards.effect: Ranged attack; on hit weapon die damage and STR save or pushed 10 ft away. No pushing through walls or into occupied squares; it can continue remaining movement afterward.

source.originalText: Repel Shot: Use your reaction to knock back a melee attacker (2 charges).

cards.name: Turret Deployment
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 2 empty squares within 10 ft
cards.effect: Deploy 2 turrets, each AC 12+PB and HP 2 L, immobile, range 60 ft. On your Bonus Action command ONE turret to attack using PB+DEX for 1d6+M piercing. Both share that single command/attack budget with other companions; no autonomous shots. Reclaimed after use, no resale.

source.originalText: Turret Deployment: Deploy up to 2 automated turrets that last 3 rounds, firing for 1d6+WIS damage and applying Snare or Disrupt effects.

cards.name: Bubble of Discipline
cards.duration: Until start of your second next turn
cards.effect: Deploy dense layered cover. Up to 3 allies inside gain+2 AC against spell attacks and advantage on DEX saves against spells from outside. Once total, Reaction reduce spell damage to one protected ally by 2 S+M. Does not negate a spell, block internal casting or protect each ally independently.

source.originalText: Bubble of Discipline: Create a 3x3 area effect that blocks 1 spell per ally for 2 rounds (once per rest).

cards.name: Intimidating Presence
cards.rangeAndTarget: Enemies within 10 ft that perceive you
cards.effect: They take-1 on saves against your Frightened effects. Never alters immunity or stacks multiple Tyrant penalties.

source.originalText: Intimidating Presence: Enemies that can see you have disadvantage on morale checks.

cards.name: Cruel Efficiency
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy you hit with a weapon on successive regular turns
cards.effect: Second and later consecutive-turn hits against same enemy add S damage. Missing all attacks or changing target ends chain. Bonus never grows beyond S and excludes Overwatch/turrets/copies.

source.originalText: Cruel Efficiency: Gain a stacking damage bonus when hitting the same target consecutively.

cards.name: Marked for Death
cards.effect: Mark foe. It takes-1 saves against your class effects and deals 1 less damage on its first hit against an ally other than you. One mark; penalty does not stack with Intimidating Presence.

source.originalText: Marked for Death: Enemies you designate take –1 to saves and deal –1 damage vs allies other than you.

cards.name: Ruthless Tactician
cards.effect: Gain advantage on one attack against a flanked enemy or enemy in difficult terrain. Terrain must actually impede it; creating harmless decoration does not qualify.

source.originalText: Ruthless Tactician: Gain advantage on attacks against enemies that are flanked or hindered by terrain.

cards.name: Crushing Decree
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies within 30 ft that hear you
cards.effect: WIS save; failure has disadvantage on attacks against allies other than you while it can perceive you. It may move, cast nonattack spells or decline attacks; no compelled suicide or removed Action.

source.originalText: Crushing Decree: Taunt enemies in range, forcing them to target you.

cards.name: Impale Line
cards.effect: Make one ranged attack against each, normal weapon damage. If both hit, both lose Reactions for duration. If only one target exists, no double attack against it and no reaction rider.

source.originalText: Impale Line: Fire a shot that travels in a 4-tile line; if it hits 2+ targets, all enemies lose their reactions.

cards.name: Execution Zone
cards.effect: Designate zone. First time each round one enemy tries to leave, Reaction weapon attack; on hit normal damage and STR save or movement ends at boundary for current turn. Teleport/forced movement works. One shot across all targets, no impassable magical wall.

source.originalText: Execution Zone: Create an area where enemies take –1 to morale and cannot escape.

cards.name: Demoralizing Shot
cards.rangeAndTarget: Visible enemy within range; up to 2 allies of it within 10 ft
cards.effect: Weapon attack normal damage. On hit secondary enemies WIS save or disadvantage on next attack. Director need not designate a privileged leader; source leadership fiction represented by visible example.

source.originalText: Demoralizing Shot: Hit an enemy leader to impose disadvantage on all nearby enemy attacks.

cards.name: Brutal Example
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy below half HP in weapon range
cards.effect: Weapon attack; on hit add 2 S d6 damage. Up to 2 enemies within 10 ft of victim WIS save or Frightened of you for duration. No automatic death threshold or fear through immunity.

source.originalText: Brutal Example: Deal massive damage to a weakened target, causing nearby enemies to become frightened.

cards.name: Final Command
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 3 willing allies within 30 ft who hear you
cards.effect: New Hero capstone. Allies may each move 10 ft without opportunity attacks and gain S+M temporary HP. You refresh one expended short-rest Soldier card, excluding Final Command and long-rest features. A refreshed card still costs its activation and ammunition; no extra turn or recursive resets.

authoringNotes: Provisional; notebook adversarial findings reconciled and source-preserving editorial review complete. Human balance testing remains.
